title: Day 7 Broncos Training Camp Report: Bo Nix Strikes Back! | Orange & Blue Today
text: After two straight days of the defense owning camp, the Broncos offense struck back on Friday — and it wasn’t subtle. The energy flipped, the execution tightened, and several key playmakers stepped up when it mattered. Bo Nix looked sharp at the end of practice, stacking completions and showing the rhythm that had been missing earlier in the week. When the offense needed a spark, Nix delivered. Pat Bryant continues to dominate. Physical routes, strong hands, chain‑moving consistency — he’s becoming one of the most reliable players on the field, period. Evan Engram made multiple big plays, including a touchdown that fired up the entire offense. His versatility is showing up daily. And it was good to see Courtland Sutton helping move the chains**, working the intermediate areas and giving Nix a steady veteran presence. After two defensive wins, Friday belonged to the offense — and it felt like a statement. 🔥 In this episode: Bo Nix finishes practice strong and in command Pat Bryant continues his camp takeover Evan Engram stacks big plays, including a TD Courtland Sutton helps steady the offense Offense responds after two straight defensive wins Drop your Broncos take — is this the start of the offense finding its groove, or just a one‑day surge.
